outputs.explanation: Panel A shows micrographs/reconstructions (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows micrographs/reconstructions analogous to A for PacL2, not a plot of averaged data.
Number of clusters per cell is shown as a scatter plot with individual gray dots per cell overlaid on the mean ± SEM, as stated in the caption.
Cluster sizes are shown as a scatter plot with individual gray dots per cluster overlaid on the mean ± SEM, as stated in the caption.
Proportion of clustered molecules per cell is shown as a scatter plot with individual gray dots per cell overlaid on the mean ± SEM, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution reconstructions and trajectory overlays (micrographs), not an averaged plot.
This is a histogram of diffusion coefficients, a plot type exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.

This is a line plot of mean square displacement over multiple trajectories; overlaying individual points on a line plot is not applicable/would be unreadable, and it already shows individual trajectory lines rather than a single average.
Panel H shows trajectories, a kymograph, and example trajectory traces (micrograph-type visualizations), not an averaged summary plot.
